473-26-16349 — Joint Application of Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC
and LCRA Transmission Service Corporation to Amend their Certificates of
Convenience and Necessity for the Bell County East Switch to Big Hill
Substation 765-kV Transmission Line Project in Bell, Burnet, Concho, Coryell,
Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCulloch, Menard, Milam, Milis, San Saba,
Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson Counties.

Chairman Gleeson, Commissioner Jackson, and Commissioner Hjlatman received the attached
correspondence pertaining to the above-styled docket.

Please note that a member or employee of a state agency assigned to render a decision in a
contested case may not directly or indirectly communicate in connection with an issue of fact
or law with any state agency, person, party, or representative of those entities, except on notice
and opportunity for each party to participate. See Administrative Procedures Act, Texas
Government Code § 2001.061.

Commission Advising is filing the correspondence, with personal information redacted.
Parties will not be served copies of the attached document but can access it through the PUC

Interchange at http://interchange.puc.texas.gov/.

To the Commissioners of the Public Utility Commission of Texas:
Docket No. 59475 — Bell County East to Big Hitt 765 kV Transmission Line Project

This letter constitutes a formal public comment and demand for record inclusion regarding
the above-referenced docket, filed by Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA
Transmission Services Corporation.

1am the owner of record of the property located at I Salado, Texas
76571, as reflected in the Bell County Appraisal District and county deed records, which

ties within the designated study area for this project. To date, neither Oncor nor LCRA TSC
has provided me with direct written notice confirming whether my property falls within a
proposed or alternate route segment, despite the scale, duration, and public prominence
of this proceeding.

Be advised of the following:

1. Under 16 Texas Administrative Code §22.52, an electric utility is required to provide first-
class mail notice to landowners within the applicable distance of a proposed route prior to
filing a licensing application. Failure to comply with this notice requirement constitutes
cause for a day-for-day extension of intervention and commission-action deadlines. If it is
determined that | was an affected landowner entitled to notice and did not receive it, |
expect that extension to apply, and | am placing the Commission on notice of a potential
procedural defect in this proceeding as it pertains to my property.

 2. 1am formally requesting written confirmation from the Commission, Oncor, and LCRA
TSC as to whether my property at the address above is located within any currently
proposed, alternate, or study-area route segment for this project, including but not limited
to Route 894 and any adjacent links.

3. | object to any routing, easement acquisition, survey access, or construction activity
affecting my property until such confirmation is provided and | have been afforded a full
and fair opportunity to participate in this docket, consistent with my rights under the Texas
Landowner’s Bill of Rights and applicable provisions of the Public Utility Regulatory Act.

4, | hereby formally request that all employees, contractors, surveyors, right-of-way agents,
and other representatives of Oncor and LCRA TSC refrain from entering my property at the
address above, for surveying, staking, appraisal, or any other purpose, until this matter is
fully resolved, my property’s status within this docket is confirmed in writing, and any right
of entry is separately and lawfully granted by me in writing. No implied consent to entry
should be inferred from any prior contact, silence, or inaction on my part.

5. ! expect this comment to be entered into the record of Docket No. 59475 in its entirety
and will follow up in writing if it is not.

6. | further request that | be added to the official service list for Docket No. 59475 so that!
receive all future filings, notices, and orders in this proceeding.

7. 1n the alternative, and in light of the notice deficiencies described above, | hereby
request leave to intervene as a party to this docket out of time, pursuant to the good-cause
and notice-defect provisions applicable under 16 TAC §22.52 and the Commission’s
procedural rules.

8. | further request copies of all records reflecting notice attempts made to my property,
including mailing lists, return receipts, or delivery confirmations used to determine notice
eligibility for this docket.

9. | request a written response to this letter within ten (10) business days of receipt.

| do not consent to any diminishment of my property rights without full due process,
adequate notice, and just compensation as required by Texas law. | intend to pursue every
available administrative and legal remedy to protect my property interests in this matter.
Nothing in this letter shall be construed as a waiver of any right, claim, or remedy available
to me under Texas law, all of which are expressly reserved.

Please direct all correspondence regarding this docket, as it relates to my property, to the
contact information below.

 Respectfully but firmly submitted
Jerry Blackwell

Salado Tx, 76571

To the Commissioners of the Public Utility Commission of Texas:

Docket No. 59475 - Bell County East to Big Hill 765 kV Transmission Line Project

This letter constitutes a formal public comment and demand for record inclusion regarding
the above-referenced docket, filed by Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA
Transmission Services Corporation.

I am the owner of record of the property located at ~ Satado, Texas
76571, as reflected in the Bell County Appraisal District and county deed records, which
lies within the designated study area for this project. To date, neither Oncor nor LCRA TSC
has provided me with direct written notice confirming whether my property falls within a
proposed or alternate route segment, despite the scale, duration, and public prominence
of this proceeding.

Be advised of the following:

1. Under 16 Texas Administrative Code §22.52, an electric utility is required to provide first-
class mail notice to landowners within the applicable distance of a proposed route prior to
filing a licensing application. Failure to comply with this notice requirement constitutes
cause for a day-for-day extension of intervention and commission-action deadlines. If it is
determ i ned th at 1 wa s a n affected landowner entitled to notice and did not receive it, I
expect that extension to apply, and I am placingthe Commission on notice of a potential
procedural defect in this proceeding as it pertains to my property.
 2. I am formally requesting written confirmation from the Commission, Oncor, and LCRA
TSC as to whether my property at the address above is located within any currently
proposed, alternate, or study-area route segment for this project, including but not limited
to Route 894 and any adjacent links.

3. I object to any routing, easement acquisition, survey access, or construction activity
affecting my property until such confirmation is provided and I have been afforded a full
and fair opportunityto participate in this docket, consistent with my rights underthe Texas
Landowner's Bill of Rights and applicable provisions of the Public Utility Regulatory Act.

4. I hereby formally request that all employees, contractors, surveyors, right-of-way agents,
and other representatives of Oncor and LCRA TSC refrain from entering my property at the
address above, for surveying, staking, appraisal, orany other purpose, untilthis matter is
fully resolved, my property's status within this docket is confirmed in writing, and any right
of entry is separately and lawfully granted by me in writing. No implied consent to entry
should be inferred from any prior contact, silence, or inaction on my part.

5. I expect this comment to be entered into the record of Docket No. 59475 in its entirety
and will follow up in writing if it is not.

6. I further request that I be added to the official service list for Docket No. 59475 so that I
receive all future filings, notices, and orders in this proceeding.

7. In the alternative, and in light of the notice deficiencies described above, I hereby
request leave to intervene as a party to this docket out of time, pursuantto the good-cause
and notice-defect provisions applicable under 16 TAC §22.52 and the Commission's
procedural rules.

8. I further request copies of all records reflecting notice attempts made to my property,
including mailing lists, return receipts, or delivery confirmations used to determine notice
eligibility forthis docket.

9. I request a written response to this letter within ten (10) business days of receipt.

I do not consentto any diminishment of my property rights without full due process,

Nothing in this letter shall be construed as a waiver of any right, claim, or remedy available

Please direct all correspondence regardingthis docket, as it relates to my property, to the
